messages:
Maria: Hey team — planning to onboard "nebula-3b-v2" into the catalog tomorrow during the 10:00–11:00 PT staging window. @Owen can you take the deploy? Need pin to nebula-3b:v2 and fallback to nebula-3b:v1. Smoke instructions below.

Owen: I can take the deploy. ETA 10:05. Will run smoke on staging and one test tenant.

Jin: I'll watch metrics and tracing. What's the canary %?

Maria: Start with 5% canary on dedicated pool, then 25% after 10m if no regressions. Rollback plan: immediate unpin to v1 + disable traffic routing.

Leah: Reminder: quantization profile "q4_0" might differ perf. We have a preflight artifact at s3://redwood-artifacts/nebula/nebula-3b-v2/preflight.json

Owen: Got it. Commands I'll run:
```bash
rwdctl catalog pin --model nebula-3b --version v2 --env staging
rwdctl deploy canary --model nebula-3b:v2 --pct 5 --monitor 600
```

infra-bot: Deploy pipeline queued — build 5632. CI tests passed.

Jin: Also add the prompt eval set "nebula-3b-smoke-v1" to the rollforward check. I'll push the webhook for alerting.

Leah: Quick QA checklist:
- verify latency p95 < 220ms
- error rate < 0.5%
- embedding drift < 0.02
- cost per token estimate ok
I'll post the smoke script after lunch.

Owen: smoke run ok on my local staging: p95 190ms, errors 0.1%. I'll start canary at 10:10.

Maria: Thanks. If any anomaly ping @oncall-eng. Otherwise I'll update the catalog entry after the 25% phase.

Jin: ACK. I'll hold the rollback command ready:
```bash
rwdctl catalog unpin --model nebula-3b --env staging
rwdctl routing set --model nebula-3b --version v1 --force
```

Owen: Canary 5% up. No alerts so far. 12m in.

Leah: I'm seeing a spike in bytes-per-request for a tenant — could be prompt change. @Owen can you pull request diff on prompts?

Owen: will do, opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/428

Maria: Nice. If the prompt change is expected, we'll continue. If unexpected, rollback.

infra-bot: Canary reached 25% automated (after health check). Traffic ramp step complete.

Jin: All green on tracing + latency. Marking this as pass. Leah, please sign off on QA.

Leah: Signed off. Will follow up in catalog metadata with quant notes.

Maria: Great — moving to final catalog pin tomorrow for prod after a short postmort evaluation. Thanks team :tada:
